question.worked_solution:
If $X$ follows a discrete uniform distribution over a set $S,$ then $X$ has the following probability mass function:

$$
f(x)=\{\begin{aligned}\frac{1}{|S|}, & x\in S \\ 0, & \text{otherwise}\end{aligned}
$$

Here, we have $X∼U\{8,9,10,…,34\},$ and the set $S=\{8,9,10,…,34\}$ has $|S|=34-8+1=27$ items. So, we have

$$
f(x)=\{\begin{aligned}\frac{1}{27}, & x=8,9,10,…,34 \\ 0, & \text{otherwise}.\end{aligned}
$$

In $S,$ the items that satisfy $12\le X\le 25$ are $12,13,14,…,25.$ There are $25-12+1=14$ of these items. Therefore,

$$
P(12\le X\le 25)=14\cdot \frac{1}{27}=\frac{14}{27}.
$$
